task:
A levy charges 13% on the first 3000 credits of a 8495-credit bill and 47% on the remainder. Subtract a 7-credit rebate from the levy (floor at zero), then apply a 7% surcharge to that reduced levy. What is the exact final levy? No rounding. After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:
Adjustment 1: add 27 credits, then discount the whole amount by 6%.
Adjustment 2: apply a 18% surcharge, then subtract 5 credits.
Adjustment 3: add 16 credits, then discount the whole amount by 4%.
Adjustment 4: apply a 7% surcharge, then subtract 7 credits.
Adjustment 5: add 22 credits, then discount the whole amount by 5%.

Adjustment 18: apply a 5% surcharge, then subtract 14 credits.
Adjustment 19: add 25 credits, then discount the whole amount by 8%.
